messages.subject: How to use Newcon lrb 4000 binocular rangefinder
parts:
I am looking for help using a Newcon LRB 4000 binocular rangefinder for L=
ine=20
Transect data recording. The device downloads each measurement of range=20=

and bearing to an excel file. It is also necessary to add observations of=
group=20
size. The task requires several observations per minute.
